dedupe_keys.name: shake table testing of a full scale urm cavity wall building euc build 1

description: A full-scale two-storey terraced-house specimen uses calcium-silicate load-bearing walls, clay-brick veneer, concrete floors and a timber roof. It is shaken with increasing induced-seismicity-compatible motions towards near collapse. The observations support assessment of cavity-wall buildings without modern seismic detailing, including the interaction of their structural and non-structural parts. The dataset is provided by EUCENTRE, Pavia through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2015. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models.
